# The finger round — every test as a script of the suite (`tools/device/finger/suite/`)

**Generated by `tools/device/finger/finger-list.py` from the suite and its last report (`docs/rounds/finger-2026-11-16/finger-report.json`, 2026-11-16).**
Edit a script's `item:` line, not this file. The round is the agent's, driven by the emulated finger on the real
input path (`tools/device/finger/`, `context/kits/cavekit-finger-emulation.md`) and judged by the check library's
oracles (`cavekit-finger-testing.md`). No item is the owner's (the owner, 2026-11-16): the few still marked a
person's — the rotation, a launch from another app, sound heard — wait for their tools (T-653), not for a person.
The hand-run record this list was until 2026-11-05 is `docs/FINGER-TESTS-2026-10.md`.
